segments.contextBefore: It calls the node’s [`play()`](skvideonode/play().md) method to start the video playback.
segments.contextAfter:
```swift
let sample = SKVideoNode(fileNamed: "sample.mov")
sample.position = CGPoint(x: frame.midX,
                          y: frame.midY)
addChild(sample)
sample.play()
```
